title: Encode and Decode Strings
keyIdea: Write each string as length + '#' + text. When decoding, read digits up to the first '#' to get the length, then take exactly that many characters, whatever they are. A separator alone can't work because words can contain it.

approaches.name: Length prefix: len#word
approaches.idea: encode: for each s, append to_string(s.size()) + '#' + s. decode: find '#' from i, parse the length, take substr(j + 1, length), jump i past it.
approaches.why: Every character is written once and read once.

quiz.q: Why not just join the words with '#'?
options: A word containing '#' would be split in the wrong place

quiz.q: While decoding, could the '#' you stop at be inside a word?
options: No: decoding always starts at a length, and whole words are jumped over
